prompt:
Our FinTech platform team noticed build times ballooned after the last two feature sprints. We have archived pipeline timing exports from before those sprints (our baseline window) and from the most recent runs (current window). Both sets of exports are sitting in `artifacts/github-actions/baseline/` and `artifacts/github-actions/current/` respectively.

I need you to run a regression analysis comparing baseline to current pipeline performance. Use the following severity thresholds: flag a job as a warning if it slowed down by more than 60 seconds OR by more than 20% relative to baseline; flag it as critical if it exceeded 150 seconds absolute slowdown OR 40% relative slowdown. We want to look at the top 10 slowest regressions.

Also, our end-to-end test job (`e2e-tests`) was just added this sprint and has no historical baseline — please exclude it entirely from the comparison so it doesn't pollute the results.

We need a machine-readable output so our cost-alerting pipeline can consume it automatically. If any jobs cross the critical threshold, the process should signal failure (exit code 1).

Save the final report as `regression-report.json`.
